column1:
SEO Website Audit: Conduct a comprehensive SEO audit to identify and fix technical issues, improve site schema, and ensure mobile-friendliness.

Keyword Research: Identify keywords relevant to your business.

Competitor Analysis: Analyze top-ranking websites to understand their strategies.
column2:
Keyword Optimization: Optimize website content (landing pages, blog posts) with targeted keywords.
Content Creation: Begin creating high-quality, informative, and engaging related content.
Citation Building: Start building local citations on relevant directories and platforms.
Local Schema Markup: Implement local schema markup to enhance local search visibility.
column3:
Content Promotion: Promote content on relevant online communities.
Local Directories: Continue building citations in local directories.
Monitoring: Set up tracking tools like Google Analytics and Google Search Console to monitor website performance and local rankings.

column1: Quarter 2: Strengthening Presence and Expanding Locally (Months 4-6)

On-Page Refinement: Review and refine on-page content based on the initial results and user engagement.

Technical SEO: Continue monitoring and optimizing site performance, ensuring it's mobile-responsive and fast-loading.

Local Content: Create location-specific content
column2: Local Link Building: Continue outreach for local backlinks from relevant websites.
column3:
Performance Analysis: Review the impact of your SEO efforts, including rankings, traffic, and conversions.
Scaling: Expand your SEO efforts for more enagement time and event duration
Content Calendar: Create a content calendar for the next quarter, focusing on user needs and trending topics.
Ongoing Maintenance: Regularly update and maintain your website, check for new technical issues, and continue monitoring performance.
